dramas.title: 30 Days Swapping Lives with a Mafia Boss
dramas.synopsis:
A freak car crash leads to the unthinkable: the refined heiress wakes up as a ruthless mob boss, while the hardened gangster sent to kidnap her is stuck in the body of a helpless heiress.
Now, they’re trapped in each other’s lives—dodging bullets, hiding secrets, and pretending to be someone they’re not.
She must survive a cutthroat underworld of crime, betrayal, and bloodshed. He’s stuck navigating high society, fake smiles, and stilettos—without blowing his cover. They can’t stand each other—but trusting one another might be their only way out.
Schemes. Secrets. Danger at every turn.
And a slow-burning attraction neither of them can outrun.

dramas.title: Royal Heir Breaks My Heart In A Warzone
dramas.synopsis: Royal Heir Breaks My Heart In A Warzone is a passionate war-time romance. Charlie, an ER doctor burdened by family obligations, reunites with her former lover Harry during a medical mission in a conflict zone. Unbeknownst to her, Harry is a prince who once left her due to a misunderstanding but never stopped loving her. Together, they face life-and-death challenges amid warfare, while Selina—a jealous medical officer—plots against Charlie, even colluding with terrorists. As the truth unfolds, Harry discovers that Charlie’s child is his own. In the end, he risks everything to rescue her and publicly declares their love, writing an unforgettable love story in the midst of war.

dramas.title: Cohabitating Lover
dramas.synopsis:
To escape an arranged marriage, the female lead, Corinne, flees to an apartment she rented—only to find the male lead, Andre, standing at the door, about to unlock it. The two argue over the ownership of the apartment, only to discover that a mistake by the leasing agency led to it being rented twice. With her credit card frozen, Corinne has no choice but to stubbornly stay in the apartment, living together with Andre. Andre tries to scare her off by undressing, but Corinne teases him instead, sparking a flirtatious tension between them.

Corinne passes an interview at a new company, only to find out that her boss is none other than Andre, who tries to fire her. Using every trick in the book, Corinne successfully convinces him to let her stay, and the two begin navigating their professional and cohabiting lives. As they adapt to each other, they gradually grow closer. However, Corinne’s fiancé, James, reappears, urging her to return and marry him. When Corinne refuses, she faces false accusations at work. Andre appears cold and indifferent, hurting Corinne—but in reality, he secretly helps her secure a new project.

Later, when their mutual friends meet at a restaurant and hit it off, a slip of the tongue reveals Andre’s hidden secret, reigniting the conflict between him and Corinne. Heartbroken, Corinne leaves the company and is found by James. Meanwhile, Andre’s mother arranges an engagement for him with Betty, pushing their relationship to a crisis...

dramas.title: Apron Down, Hornbook Up
dramas.synopsis:
After three years of giving up her career as a legendary lawyer to support her husband’s rise to fame, a devoted wife watches silently as he reconnects with his first love. Though hurt, she remains understanding—until a humiliating dinner with his friends forces her to confront how much of herself she’s lost.

Leaving only a letter behind, she returns to her former firm and reclaims her reputation as the “Queen of Law.” When her husband discovers she was once his most respected rival, he confronts her, only to hear her quiet revelation: she gave up everything for love, but now realizes that to be loved, she must first love herself.

dramas.title: My Wife's Fake Amnesia
dramas.synopsis:
For fifteen years, I was their adopted son; I married their daughter.  Then, a twist of fate: an "accident" stole my wife's memory and she demanded a divorce. On her wedding day to another, I was brutally attacked and left to die.

But death was not the end. I awoke five years in the past, reborn on the day my wife lost her memory. Determined to rewrite my future, I vowed to let her go. That’s when I uncovered the truth: her amnesia was an elaborate lie, carefully orchestrated for another man. My heart turned to ash. I sought a divorce, ready to walk away with nothing.

Yet her cruelty knew no limits. To humiliate me completely, she had me stripped naked and publicly driven out of the company in front of all our peers.

What she never knew was that I am the hidden heir to a billionaire’s empire. She thought she was casting off a worthless pawn. Now, I will make sure the weight of her regret finally crushes her.
